description: Header file defining the DrmManager class and related DRM management components for Android, including method declarations, class structures, and external dependencies.

classes.name: DrmManager
classes.description: Main class for managing DRM operations, delegating to DRM engines, handling sessions, and metrics.

methods.name: addUniqueId
methods.description: Adds a unique identifier for a DRM client.

methods.name: removeUniqueId
methods.description: Removes a previously added unique identifier.

methods.name: loadPlugIns
methods.description: Loads DRM plugins, optionally from a specified directory.

methods.name: unloadPlugIns
methods.description: Unloads all DRM plugins.

methods.name: setDrmServiceListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for DRM service events for a specific client.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves DRM constraints for a given content path and action.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a DRM-protected content.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the DRM system can handle a specific content type.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Acquires DRM information based on a request.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves rights/licenses for DRM content.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of a DRM content.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Gets the DRM object type for a content.

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks the rights status for a content.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights/licenses for DRM content.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Sets playback status for DRM content.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates if an action is permissible on a content.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights/licenses for a specific content.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all rights/licenses.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Opens a conversion session for DRM content.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: getAllSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves support information for DRM.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a decryption session for DRM content.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes a decryption session.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of DRM content.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads data from a decrypted content stream.

methods.name: onInfo
methods.description: Handles DRM info events.

methods.name: initMetricsLooper
methods.description: Initializes the metrics looper for DRM engine metrics.
